description: K breakdown for 'which unit fights next'. _score_fighter_priority is an itemised ledger (sum == score, difficulty noise booked as its own term) and the SELECT_FIGHTER step records every offered unit with its planned priority, so the card compares the activation candidates.

steps.comment: Setup: decline any stratagem window, then play the AI's own suggested steps (pile-ins) until the 'which unit fights next' decision is reached.
